core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kaynat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Universe, creation, beings”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kaynat corresponds to the Arabic form كائنات (Plural of كَائِن; كَائِنَات (Kāʾināt)). Its core sense is universe, creation, beings. Kaynat is Arabic كَائِنَات (Kāʾināt) 'universe, creation, beings', the plural of كَائِن (kāʾin). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave the broken form كَيْناَت and glossed the name 'The giver or distributor'; the correct form is كَائِنَات. Same name as kainat.
